title: Apply to CRGD
intro: Choose the form that fits you. Each takes about fifteen to twenty minutes. Keep a link to your CV ready, on Google Drive or similar, and a writing sample where the form asks for one.

forms.title: Research Associates and Researchers
forms.label: Research team
forms.description: For graduates and experienced researchers who want to join CRGD's research team, full time or part time. You will need your CV, one writing sample and a referee.

forms.title: Fellowships
forms.label: Fellowships
forms.description: For students, professionals and journalists applying for a CRGD fellowship with a research proposal. You will need your CV, one writing sample and a referee.

forms.title: Internships
forms.label: Internships
forms.description: For students applying for a research or communications internship. You will need your CV. A writing sample is recommended for research internships.

forms.title: Co-ordinator Program
forms.label: Co-ordinator Program
forms.description: For students and young professionals who want to represent CRGD on their campus or in their district. You will need your CV.

forms.title: Start a Policy Club
forms.label: Campus Clubs
forms.description: For colleges and schools registering a CRGD Policy Club. You will need details of the student lead and a faculty adviser.
